why: The reference answers 500 for a delete of a missing record (an MST conflict); locus answers 400 with the reason.
As above: InvalidRequest instead of InternalServerError.
The reference answers 500 when an app-password name is already used (a database constraint); locus answers 400 InvalidRequest.
As above: InvalidRequest instead of InternalServerError.
The reference answers 500 for a body that isn't a CAR; locus answers 400 InvalidRequest with the reason. (Reference bug; §1.3 has no row for it.)
As above: InvalidRequest instead of InternalServerError.
The reference answers 500 for an atproto-proxy header whose DID isn't a DID; locus answers 400 InvalidRequest. (Reference bug; §1.3 has no row for it.)
As above: InvalidRequest instead of InternalServerError.
The reference answers 500 when an operator sets an email another account uses (a database constraint); locus answers 400 InvalidRequest. (Reference bug; §1.3 has no row for it.)
As above: InvalidRequest instead of InternalServerError.
Locus signs OAuth access tokens with a dedicated ES256 key and publishes it; the reference signs with its HS256 secret and publishes none.
admin.searchAccounts is a locus addition; the reference doesn't serve it (it tries to proxy it and refuses Basic auth).
With no SMTP, the reference silently 'sends'; locus answers InvalidRequest 'Email is not configured on this server'.
Locus answers a password reset for an unknown email the same as for a known one; the reference reveals that no account has it.
With no SMTP, the reference answers {sent: true}; locus refuses: the moderation sender isn't configured.
A service-auth token on a procedure is single-use on locus (jti replay cache); the reference has no replay check and answers the reused token as a fresh one.
